desc:
This is a Crossover to the Existing RGD and TBB, it has TBB gameplay with RGD Assets!

ABOUT THE UPDATE: We Decided to Delay the update, to around New Years (or earlier), since we are Currently going back to older Content and Revamping most of it! (We'll be Giving Circuits to Compensate!)

THIS GAME IS CURRENTLY IN BETA!!!
If you havent played either RGD or TBB, i recommend playing those first!
1K Visits has not been celebrated yet, same with 10K! which means both drop at once, when the update is released.

Expect bugs, if you find one, please report them in our server!
